explanation: Gift-giving in Saudi business culture is a welcomed, trust-building gesture as long as it stays modest and avoids being perceived as a bribe, with items like dates, high-quality coffee, or sweets as safe choices. Gifts should be given and received with the right hand or both hands together, never the left, and should avoid alcohol, pork products, or anything with explicit religious imagery.
local_tip: Present the gift with your right hand or both hands, and keep it modest rather than extravagant.

also_check.note: Gift-giving is highly ritualized; wrapping and presentation matter greatly, and both hands are used to present a gift.
Business gifts are often seen as unnecessary; if given, keep them small and practical.
Gifts help build relationships, but clocks, umbrellas, or sharp objects are avoided as symbols of bad luck.

sources.title: Gift Giving Etiquette in the Middle East
